headline: Elected 2026 chair and vice chair, and sent letter on McKay Street sidewalk review
summary: The committee heard updates from various boards on topics including the Trask Lane project, Lynch Park, and Parks & Recreation equipment. It discussed several open space and trail projects by ward, elected a chair and vice chair for 2026, and approved prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Motion carried 8-0 to have David write a letter to Ward 3 Councilor Steve Crowley recommending City Engineering review the sidewalk on McKay Street.
Motion carried 7-0-1 to nominate David Alden-St. Pierre as Chair of the Open Space & Recreation Committee.
Motion carried 7-0-1 to nominate David Brewster as Vice Chair of the Open Space & Recreation Committee.
Motion carried 8-0 to approve the October 1, 2025 meeting minutes as presented.
Motion carried 8-0 to approve the November 5, 2025 meeting minutes as presented.
